features.h2: One tool for your entire working day
features.intro: Instead of three programs and duplicate data entry: with Valanto you work end to end in one place – from the first valuation to finished marketing.

items.d: All your properties in one place – each with a complete dossier. You'll find everything again when you need it.
Create traceable valuations and export them as a clean dossier – ready for your clients.
Set up projects, manage units and keep an eye on the sales status at any time.
A dedicated marketing page for every property – no extra software, no web agency needed.
Your sellers can check the status themselves at any time – fewer questions, fewer status emails for you.

features.next: CRM and prospect management, directly in Valanto.

items.text: Manage, market, steer projects – without constantly switching programs.
Traceable valuations with a professional dossier. Quickly created, cleanly exported.
You do both? Then with Valanto you have everything on one continuous platform – with all modules.

pricing.intro: Price per user, per month, cancel any month. To try it out, every company gets one free seat with one property, one valuation and one new-build project – no time limit.
pricing.note: All prices excl. VAT · All plans compliant with the Swiss FADP (revDSG), hosted in Switzerland. · Custom solutions for larger teams on request.

boxes.t: One account per company, one plan per user
boxes.d: You set up the company and invite your employees one by one. Plans may be mixed – two brokers and one valuer are not a special case.
3 people: 1 × free seat, plus 1 × Broker and 1 × Valuer = CHF 130.– per month, excl. VAT. Seats can be added or removed at any time.

siv.text: Valanto grows out of the daily work of valuation. That keeps the platform close to what you really need in practice – rather than what off-the-shelf software offers.

points.d: We handle your data in accordance with Swiss data protection law – hosted in Switzerland with Infomaniak (Geneva).
Your feedback goes straight into development. We're a small team, not a ticketing system.
